OVERRIDES
  --set provider.max_output_tokens="4096"
  --set provider.reasoning.effort="medium"
  --set provider.temperature="0.2"
  --set provider.top_p="0.9"

MODEL & PROVIDER
  model:           "golden-model"
  provider type:   "openai"
  base_url:        "https://api.deepseek.com"
  request_timeout: default (120s)
  retry:           3 attempts (default), 1s initial backoff (default)
  dialect:         "deepseek"
  max_output_tokens: 4096 (overridden via --set)
  provider mapping (the wire fields this config will send):
    max_output_tokens: 4096 -> max_tokens: 4096 (overridden via --set)
    reasoning.effort: medium -> thinking: {"type":"enabled"} (overridden via --set)
    reasoning.effort: medium -> reasoning_effort: high (deepseek has no medium) (overridden via --set)
    temperature: 0.2 -> temperature: 0.2 (overridden via --set)
    top_p: 0.9 -> top_p: 0.9 (overridden via --set)
    temperature/top_p: sent but ignored by deepseek in thinking mode (thinking is on by default)

TOOLS
  workspace: "<TMP>"
  fs builtins (fs_read, fs_write, fs_list): disabled
  shell: disabled
  subprocess tools: (none)

REQUIREMENTS
  env:
    TEST_KEY        ✓ set

PERMISSIONS
  default policy: allow (unset)
  per-tool overrides: (none)
  note: without a TTY, every "ask" policy is auto-denied (headless fail-safe).

BUDGETS
  max_turns:  20
  max_tokens: UNBOUNDED (no token budget)
  timeout:    none
  max_tool_result_bytes: built-in per-tool caps (fs_read 256 KiB, fs_list/subprocess/shell 64 KiB per stream, mcp 64 KiB)

CONCURRENCY
  lock: disabled (concurrent runs of this config are allowed)
  tool calls in a turn: parallel (default)

OUTPUT
  schema: none (final answer is unconstrained text)

SESSION
  session_dir: none (no audit log)
  max_logged_field: 8192 (default)

WARNINGS
  - limits.max_tokens is 0: no token budget bounds this run
  - session_dir is not set: no session log (audit trail) will be written
